_doc: Knowledge base for the onboarding tour (xc-tour.js). Add a tour: append to tours[] with id, match (regex on location.pathname), trigger ('first-visit' auto-starts once, 'manual' only from the 带我入门 button), steps[] {selector, title{zh,en}, body{zh,en}, placement?, action?, cap?}. A step whose selector is missing is skipped. Text may use {name} (the picked assistant). cap: real | demo | soon — 'soon' beats are spoken as coming soon.

factory.note: Projects / Issues / Tree / Graph / AoI pages

keys.note: BYOK voice + image keys stored encrypted via /settings

organize.note: Periodic conversation organizing — demo panel; real today: manual 生成卡片 from a chat

tasks.note: Secretary task handling — demo panel; real today: 任务 tab + card approve/execute

opener.zh: 嘎，我是李黑鸭，废话少说。
opener.en: Quack. Duck Lee here — I'll keep it short.

opener.zh: 嗨！我是斯巴达，笔记本已经打开啦～
opener.en: Hi! Sparky here, notebook already open~
Yo, Forty Cents on the mic — keep up.

opener.zh: 在下武天，静心听我道来。
哈喽，我是狒狒，事情交给我稳稳的。
opener.en: Hello, Feifei here — leave it to me, nice and steady.

title.zh: 我是你的导游，也是你的助手

beats.zh: 我可以带你逛工厂、教你怎么聊天、给你看我们所有的特色功能。
beats.en: I can walk you around the factory, teach you how to chat, and show you all our special features.

beats.zh: 我是你的导游，也是你的助手。
beats.en: I'm your tour guide, and your assistant too.

beats.zh: 我是你的管家，你的钥匙也都可以放在我这儿——API Key 在 Setting 里加密保管。
beats.en: I'm your butler — you can keep your keys with me; API keys are stored encrypted in Setting.

beats.zh: 你只管跟我聊，秘书的活我来做：定期整理你和我的所有对话，
beats.en: You just talk to me — I'll do the secretary work: I regularly organize all our conversations,

beats.zh: 有什么不懂的你都可以来问我。
beats.en: If anything's unclear, just ask me.

body.zh: 左上角的 Logo 随时带你回到首页。
body.en: The logo always brings you back home.

body.zh: 工厂按 Linear 的结构组织：先有项目，再有 Issue。
body.en: Organized like Linear: projects first, then issues.

body.zh: 点这里建你的第一个项目，我会帮你拆成 Issue。
body.en: Create your first project here; I'll help split it into issues.

body.zh: 每行都能看 Issues，也能跳到 Graph 看关系。
body.en: Each row opens its Issues or jumps to the Graph.

body.zh: AoI 用证据说话：每个节点的进度和验证都在这里。
body.en: AoI is evidence-first: progress and verification for every node.

body.zh: 余额、模型、皮肤、语音和你的钥匙都在这里。
body.en: Balance, model, skin, voice and your keys live here.

body.zh: 我在这里。点开就能问我，或者再带你走一遍。
body.en: I'm right here — open me to ask, or take this tour again.

body.zh: 整理、报告、提醒、任务——秘书的活都在这张台子上，点开看看。
body.en: Organizing, reports, reminders, tasks — the secretary desk. Have a look.

body.zh: 每位小助手有自己的性格和声音，随时可以「更换」。
body.en: Each assistant has its own personality and voice; switch anytime.

body.zh: 这里换聊天模型，界面皮肤也会跟着变。
body.en: Switch chat models here; the skin follows.

body.zh: 开一个新会话，跟我聊就行。
body.en: Start a new chat and just talk to me.

body.zh: 写字、粘贴、加附件都在这里，⌘↵ 发送。
body.en: Type, paste or attach here; ⌘↵ to send.

body.zh: 打开生图：输入描述就是文生图，拖一张图进来就是图生图。
body.en: Image mode: type for text-to-image, drop a picture for image-to-image.

title.zh: 卡片 / 作品 / 任务

body.zh: 聊完可以一键生成卡片，审批后我去执行。
body.en: Turn a chat into a card; once approved, I execute it.

body.zh: 你的 API Key 交给我保管，加密存放。
body.en: Leave your API keys with me — stored encrypted.

body.zh: 我会定期整理对话、出报告、提醒你、办任务，都在这里。
body.en: I regularly organize chats, write reports, remind you and handle tasks — all here.

body.zh: Tree 大树、Graph 气泡、实时快照，同一份数据三种看法。
body.en: Tree, Graph bubbles and live snapshot — one dataset, three views.

body.zh: 节点要有证据才算 verified，点开能看来源。
body.en: A node is verified only with evidence; open it to see sources.

body.zh: 按层级看工作节点。
body.en: See work nodes as a hierarchy.

body.zh: 按关系看，谁依赖谁一目了然。
body.en: See relationships and dependencies at a glance.

body.zh: 选类型和父节点，把工作挂进大树。
body.en: Pick a type and parent to add work to the tree.

body.zh: 不知道填什么？先跑个 Demo 看看。
body.en: Not sure what to enter? Run the demo first.

body.zh: 账户信息、余额、额度、用量和充值。
body.en: Account info, balance, quota, usage and top-up.

body.zh: 小助手设定、模型、语音，还能制作你自己的小助手。
body.en: Assistant personas, model, voice — and build your own.

body.zh: 语音和生图的 API Key 放我这儿，加密保管；费用你直接付给服务商。
body.en: Voice and image API keys live with me, encrypted; you pay providers directly.

body.zh: 账户和余额一眼看清。
body.en: Account and balance at a glance.

body.zh: 额度不够了在这里充值。
body.en: Top up here when credit runs low.

body.zh: 每位小助手的开场白和声音都能改。
body.en: Edit each assistant’s opening line and voice.

body.zh: 导入素材，造一个你专属的小助手。
body.en: Import materials and build your own assistant.

body.zh: 语音和生图的 API Key 放我这儿，加密保管；费用你直接付给服务商。
body.en: Voice and image API keys live with me, encrypted; you pay providers directly.

organize.zh: 整理了 3 段对话 → 生成卡片「工厂首页改版」
归档 5 段闲聊，提炼 2 条待办

reports.zh: 完成：生图上线、滚动修复。进行中：新手引导。风险：无。
reports.en: Done: image gen, scroll fix. In progress: onboarding. Risks: none.

reports.zh: 上线 6 项功能，2 个 Bug 修复，余额消耗 $4.8。

reminders.zh: 看一下 AoI 新证据
续费 Ark API Key 额度
reminders.en: Top up Ark API key credit

tasks.zh: 把今天的对话整理成卡片
给项目 A 写周报
tasks.en: Write weekly report for project A

greeting._doc: Silent text greeting bubble shown when the assistant appears (first visit or 呼叫). No audio. Yes → start tour; No → decline line, stay idle.

text.zh: 嗨，我来了。我是你的助手，我是{name}。我是你的管家，也是你的导游，我来给你介绍这里的东西。要不要我现在带你看看？
text.en: Hi, I'm here. I'm your assistant, I'm {name}. I'm your butler and your tour guide, here to introduce things to you. Want me to walk you through them now?

decline.zh: 没问题，以后有什么不懂的随时问我。
decline.en: No problem. If anything's unclear later, just ask me.

greeting.yesWords: ^\s*(要|好|好的|好呀|好啊|可以|行|嗯|带我|看看|现在|yes|yeah|yep|sure|ok|okay|please|let'?s go)
greeting.noWords: (不用|不要|不需要|算了|下次|以后再|^\s*no\b|nope|not now|no thanks|later)
